   "instruction": "Complete these questions and answers.",
   "items": ["Example: Excuse me, I'm looking ................for................ a post office.",
    "1 No problem. There's one just over there on the other ......................... of the road.",
    "2 Can you ......................... me the way to the nearest bank, please?",

   "instruction": "Which words match these definitions? The first letter of each word is given to help you.",
   "items": ["Example: He or she keeps order on the streets. (police officer)....",
    "1 Trains arrive and leave from here. (r.......................... s..........................)",
    "2 You can buy stamps and send parcels and letters here. (p...................... o..........................)",
    "3 These words are on doors to show you the way in and the way out of a building or area. (E...................... ; E......................)",

    "7 This is a part of town where people can only go on foot. (p...................... a..........................)",
    "8 There are lots of different shops here. (s....................... c.......................",
    "9 Local government takes place here. (t.......................... h.......................)",
    "10 You can leave your car here. (c.......................... p.......................)]}
